question: In 2025, what share of orders contained more than one item line? Compare average ordered units per order for one-line and multi-line orders; also report orders with no item line separately.

action.query:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT IS NULL OR i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 0 THEN 'No item line'
    WHEN i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 1 THEN 'One item line'
    ELSE 'Multi item lines'
  END AS order_item_line_group,
  COUNT(o.ORDER_ID) AS order_count,
  SUM(i.ITEM_QUANTITY) AS total_ordered_quantity,
  AVG(i.ITEM_QUANTITY) AS avg_ordered_quantity_per_order
FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER o
LEFT JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_ITEM_ROLLUP i
  ON o.ORDER_ID = i.ORDER_ID
WHERE o.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND o.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 
  CASE order_item_line_group 
    WHEN 'No item line' THEN 1 
    WHEN 'One item line' THEN 2 
    ELSE 3 
  END;

action.answer:
In 2025, there were no orders with zero item lines (no such group appeared in the data). Out of all orders:
- 1,307,684 orders (about 30%) contained exactly one item line.
- 3,052,089 orders (about 70%) contained more than one item line.

Share of orders with more than one item line: 3,052,089 / (1,307,684 + 3,052,089) = 0.700090 (70.0090%).

Average ordered units per order:
- For one-line orders: 1.219753 units per order.
- For multi-line orders: 3.484769 units per order.

Interpretation: The majority of orders (70.0090%) contained more than one item line, and these multi-line orders had a much higher average number of ordered units per order (3.484769) compared to single-line orders (1.219753). No orders were found with zero item lines in 2025.
